source.why_this_clip: A pink ice-cream bar on a stick floats tilted against a painted sky and checkered floor and drifts slightly as it turns. The interval starts after the ESKIMO PIE title dissolves out at 10.75 s and ends before the striped curtain covers it and the cut at 13.5 s; the curtain edge enters on the left from 12.5 s but does not reach the bar until after 13.0 s.
